templates.label: Pranzo o cena con ingredienti
templates.intent: The contact listed food ingredients or aliments (often several items) and seems to want a meal prepared with them.
templates.when_to_use: Use when the message is primarily a list of ingredients/foods (e.g. four alimenti like pomodori, mozzarella, basilico, olio) and they have not already specified lunch vs dinner clearly.
templates.body:
Hai elencato questi ingredienti: {{ingredients}}.
Vuoi che ti prepari il *pranzo* o la *cena* con questi?

slots.name: ingredients
slots.description: Comma-separated list of the food items/ingredients mentioned, preferably in Italian, without trailing punctuation.

templates.label: Conferma generica
templates.intent: Polite short acknowledgement when no specialized template fits.
templates.when_to_use: Fallback only when no other template clearly matches the inbound text.
templates.body: Grazie per il messaggio — ti rispondo a breve.
